newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ariadne sells unit trust stake for A$25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ariadne sells unit trust stake for A$25 mln.

text.p: Australian investment company Ariadne Australia Ltd said on Tuesday it has agreed to sell its 50 percent stake in the Bradley Services Unit Trust (BSUT) to Swiss testing company SGS Societe Generale de Surveillance Holding SA for A$25 million.
Final settlement was conditional upon relevant statutory consents, but was expected in July.
Ariadne would then realise a profit in excess of A$20 million, it said.
Proceeds from the sale, including receivables, would give Ariadne an estimated A$31 million in cash, of which A$28 million would be received at settlement and the balance in the period to October.
"It is proposed that the sale proceeds will be in part applied to reduce group debt with excess proceeds held for appropriate reinvestment activities," Ariadne said.
Trading in the company's shares was halted on Monday pending the announcement. The shares were trading at 55 cents at 10.15 a.m. (0015 GMT) on Tuesday, up five cents from Monday's close.
BSUT provides infrastructure services to a consulting pathology business in Brisbane.
